name: Ranjan Kumar Das

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ranjan Kumar Das combines literary work in Odia and English with a career in public administration. A 2018 interview with him as Jajpur Collector discusses his poetry, nonfiction and translations of Russian poetry into Odia. Sahitya Akademi’s 2020–21 annual report also identifies him as an Odia poet and, at that time, Director of Odisha’s language, literature and culture department.

His English poem ‘Being Nowhere’ follows a solitary figure who finds company in wind, water, trees and soil while remaining apart from family and public life. The landscape offers solace, but the closing lines disturb that comfort with a stark account of isolation. The poem holds refuge and estrangement in the same view.
